body:
## Pull request overview

This PR migrates the Console CRUD dialog from a manual `Dialog` + `ObjectForm` composition to the unified `ModalForm` component, enabling auto-layout intelligence, automatic modal sizing based on field count, and consistent platform-level form enhancements.

**Changes:**
- Replace 45-line Dialog+ObjectForm block with ModalForm component in Console
- Remove hardcoded `columns: 1` configuration to enable auto-layout inference (≤3 fields → 1col, 4+ → 2col)
- Enable automatic modal width upgrades (2 cols → lg, 3 cols → xl, 4+ → full)
- Add comprehensive integration tests covering create/edit modes, auto-layout, and field filtering
- Update ROADMAP documentation to mark migration complete

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Migrates CRUD dialog from Dialog+ObjectForm to ModalForm, removes hardcoded columns:1, preserves field visibility filtering and all callbacks |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ConsoleModalForm.test.tsx | Adds 7 integration tests covering create/edit rendering, open/close state, auto-layout column inference (1 vs 2 columns), and field visibility filtering |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks Console ModalForm migration complete in Phase 4 ObjectForm auto-layout section |
| ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md | Updates CRUD dialog description to reflect ModalForm usage as unified modal form entry |
